call_points.text: Management expects 60-70% of the current order book to be executed in FY27.
Order book split: wagons about ₹3,000 Cr, wheelsets about ₹700 Cr, commercial vehicle about ₹500 Cr, BESS about ₹500 Cr.
About 7,000 wagons are pending as of Q1FY27.
Stone India is expected to turn EBITDA positive from Q3FY27 and reach 15%+ EBITDA from FY28.
Jupiter Electric Mobility is expected to turn EBITDA positive only from FY28.
Funding for the West Bengal BESS projects is not decided yet, between internal accruals and debt.
New Indian Railways wagon orders have no timeline; management says it is waiting for Railways to firm up requirements.
BESS project IRR is guided at 15%+ because of in-house container, BMS and EMS manufacturing.
Management aspires to reach ₹10,000 crore in revenue by 2030 with at least 15% EBITDA margins.
Stone India received RDSO approval for freight brake systems with commercial production starting July 2026.

operating_notes.text: Unutilised proceeds from the November 2023 QIP stood at ₹43.64 crore as of March 31, 2026.
JEM Energy targeted ₹200 crore BESS order book for FY27 and ₹1,000 crore revenue vision by FY30.
Subsidiary JTRWF signed a 10-year supply agreement with Tatravagonka a.s. to export ~50,000 wheelsets annually from its greenfield Odisha plant.
Stone India Ltd booked ₹17.81 crore as exceptional item in FY26 towards differential port lease rent dues.
Fully utilized July 2024 QIP net proceeds of ₹783.24 crores by the end of Q4FY26.
Order book as of March 31, 2026 stood at ₹4,675 crore.
Promoter entity Tatravagonka a.s. increased shareholding to 68.31% via warrant conversion.
Management targets INR10,000 crore in revenue by 2030 with at least 15% EBITDA margins.
Odisha wheelset plant interim production is slated for March 2027 and final commissioning by March 2028.
Average wagon realisation was ₹41,50,000 in Q1FY27 versus ₹38,00,000 a year earlier.
About 7,000 wagons were pending as of Q1FY27.
The Odisha wheel plant has a rated capacity of 100,000 wheelsets, with about 50% earmarked for captive and domestic use and 50% for exports.

timeline.summary: TATRAVAGÓNKA a.s. via **Peter Malec**, Deputy Chairman, declared no encumbrance on Jupiter Wagons shares for FY2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Jupiter Wagons filed monitoring agency reports for Q4FY26 showing ₹43.64 crore unutilised from its November 2023 QIP.
Vikash Lohia, Dy.Managing Director and Promoter, disclosed no encumbrance on JWL shares by the Promoter Group and Promoters for FY2025-26 on 03.04.2026.
On May 25, 2026, Jupiter Wagons announced that its subsidiary JEM Energy secured BESS MoUs with Chalukya Power and Pickrenew Energy, targeting a ₹200 crore order book for FY27.
On May 27, 2026, Jupiter Wagons announced that its subsidiary JTRWF signed a 10-year definitive supply agreement with Tatravagonka a.s. to export ~50,000 wheelsets annually.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹780.15 Cr (-25.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹28.83 Cr (-72.1% YoY).
On May 30, 2026, Jupiter Wagons filed the statement of deviation or variation in fund utilization under Regulation 32 for Q4FY26.
On June 1, 2026, Jupiter Wagons reported Q4 and FY26 financial results with consolidated revenue of ₹2,961 crore and PAT of ₹166 crore.
Jupiter Wagons Limited shared the audio recording link for its Analysts/Investor Meet on Q4 FY 2026 results held June 1, 2026.
On June 1, 2026, Jupiter Wagons hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call discussing operational performance and strategic growth outlook.
On 18 August 2026 Jupiter Wagons told analysts Q1FY27 revenue rose 46% to ₹671 Cr with EBITDA up 9% to ₹65 Cr, and put its BESS order book at over ₹500 Cr.
On October 23, 2026, Jupiter Wagons signed an MoU with Poland's PESA to explore passenger rolling stock opportunities in India.
Jupiter Wagons secured a ₹1,140 Cr order from Ministry of Railways for 2,583 wagons on October 28, 2026.
